item.tib: gtsug gtor gdugs dkar rigs sngags rgyal mo'i gzungs kyi sgo 'byed rnam par bshad pa bon gyi rgyal mtshan mthon po
item.coloph: ces gtsug gtor gdugs dkar gyi rnam bshad rgyal mtshan mthon po 'di ni/ mtshungs med bstan 'gro'i dpal mgon gsang grags rin po ches 'di lta bu dgos kyi bka' shog spyi bor phebs pa'i tshe/ dag pa ye shes kyi snang bas dkag ste/ ma dag nying 'khrul gyi snang ngor lha mo gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i/ mjal snang bden med rdzun gyi rang bzhin shar ba dang / snying gi thig le sher seng sogs don gnyer can gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ me mo hor zla gsum pa'i 'phel phyogs su grub pa gshen gyi gnas mchog g.yung drung gling du kun grags kyis bgyis pa 'dis kyang / bstan pa'i brgyan dang sems can gyi don rgya chen por 'grub par gyur cig/
